name: dogfood-redpanda-schema-registry
description: Dogfood app (v1.31-3) — a Redpanda + Confluent-shaped schema-registry pipeline that exercises 4 v1 patterns (register 3 Avro schemas across 3 subjects + subject naming strategy / schema evolution across 2 versions of User with a backward-compatible added optional field / BACKWARD vs FORWARD vs FULL compatibility rejection surface / producer publishes payloads that fail-fast on incompatible schema register before publish) + 4 v2 axes (BACKWARD_TRANSITIVE evolution chain walk / TopicNameStrategy + RecordNameStrategy + TopicRecordNameStrategy probe / Redpanda Console admin API 4-endpoint walk / Redpanda v23+ + Console v2.x testcontainers duck-typing) driven by @kiwa-test/streaming v0.3 in KIWA_MODE=mock and a Redpanda v23+ + Console v2.x testcontainers pair in KIWA_MODE=real (env-gated on REDPANDA_KEY). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate + Playwright e2e for register / evolution / transitive / strategy / admin / probe flows.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/streaming -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
